query: Explain how `extract_text_to_fp` in `pdfminer/high_level.py` converts a PDF into output: which options it honours, how it chooses the output device for each output type, how it prepares the output stream and the resource manager, and how it processes the pages and finishes.

operations.name: Debug mode raises the root logger to DEBUG
An image writer is created only when an output directory is given
The output device is a text, XML, HTML or hOCR converter depending on the output type
An unsupported output type raises a value error
Every selected page is interpreted and the device is closed at the end

dependencies.name: Standard output is replaced by its binary buffer when a non-text output type is written to it
Caching is controlled by one flag that feeds both the resource manager and the page loader
Scale and layout mode only influence the HTML converter
The requested rotation is added to each page's own rotation modulo 360 before the page is processed
